technologies.name: Engineered Stereoselective Hydrolase
technologies.description: Plant-derived alpha/beta hydrolase engineered for stereoselective catalysis during signaling and industrial substrate conversion.

technologies.name: CRISPR-Cas9 Double-Strand Break Nuclease
technologies.description: RNA-guided endonuclease generating targeted double-strand breaks for gene knockout via non-homologous end joining (NHEJ).

technologies.name: Prime Editing (PE2 / PE3 / bi-PE)
technologies.description: Search-and-replace gene editing fusing Cas9 nickase with reverse transcriptase, writing edits directly without DSBs or donor DNA.

technologies.name: Engineered PETase / Cutinase Biocatalytic Depolymerization
technologies.description: Enzymatic depolymerization of polyethylene terephthalate (PET) into terephthalic acid (TPA) and ethylene glycol (EG).

experiments.treatment_intervention: Bi-PE dual pegRNA transfection targeting genomic loci
experiments.control_group: Standard PE3 prime editing with single pegRNA
experiments.limitations: Assayed in transformed HEK293T cells; in vivo delivery not evaluated.
Knockout mediated by indel disruption; cannot perform precise base substitution.

experiments.exposure_duration: 0.13 mg/cm²/day mass loss at 30 °C; 60 mg film fully degraded after 6 weeks
experiments.limitations: ["Strictly mesophilic enzyme; irreversible thermal denaturation above 40 \u00b0C (Tm ~ 46.5 \u00b0C).", "Completely inactive against commercial bottle-grade crystalline PET (30-35% crystallinity).", "Enzyme secretion titer from native host is negligible; requires recombinant E. coli expression.", "Structure is completely unknown in April 2016; catalytic pocket configuration unverified."]

experiments.biological_question: Depolymerization efficacy of IsPETase double mutant (S238F/W159H)
experiments.experimental_method: High-resolution X-ray crystallography & recombinant variant assay
experiments.exposure_duration: ~20% improvement in amorphous PET degradation rate over wild-type; active site cleft narrowed
experiments.limitations: ["Engineering focused on active-site pocket did not improve melting temperature (Tm ~ 46.5 \u00b0C).", "Remains completely incapable of hydrolyzing biaxially oriented bottle PET without prior thermal destruction.", "Modest ~1.2-fold improvement is insufficient to alter batch bioprocess kinetics."]

experiments.biological_question: Depolymerization efficacy of Engineered Leaf-branch Compost Cutinase (LCC-ICCG / LCC-WCCG)
experiments.experimental_method: High-temperature 500 mL & 5 L stirred-tank batch bioreactor
experiments.exposure_duration: 90% depolymerization into terephthalic acid (TPA) and ethylene glycol (EG) within 9.3 hours at 3 mg enzyme / g PET loading
experiments.limitations: ["Completely reliant on upstream thermal amorphization: Virgin bottles (30% crystalline) MUST be melted at 260 \u00b0C and flash-quenched before enzyme exposure.", "Operating at 72 \u00b0C requires continuous pH neutralization (NaOH titrant), generating massive inorganic salt waste (Na2SO4) upon acid precipitation.", "Enzyme lifetime at 72 \u00b0C is limited to ~15-20 hours; catalyst cannot be recycled without extensive cooling/reheating.", "LCC is a distinct metagenomic cutinase family, not an IsPETase derivative."]

experiments.experimental_method: Structure-based neural network (mutCompute) + circular dichroism + 50 °C reaction
experiments.exposure_duration: Complete depolymerization of untreated post-consumer amorphous containers in 24-48 hours at 50 °C; Tm increased by 8.2 °C
experiments.limitations: ["Activity at 50 \u00b0C remains well below PET glass transition (Tg ~ 65-70 \u00b0C); still requires amorphized feedstock or thermoform waste for high conversion.", "Enzyme loading is relatively high (3-5 mg / g PET), driving biocatalyst OPEX.", "Membrane ultrafiltration recycling is theoretically proposed but subject to oligomeric pore fouling."]

experiments.biological_question: Depolymerization efficacy of Commercialized Cutinases & Engineered PETases
experiments.experimental_method: Continuous demonstration facility data & mass balance reconciliation
experiments.exposure_duration: Reconciliation of commercial economics: Amorphization extruder energy accounts for 31% of total cost; NaOH/H2SO4 neutralization consumes 2.1 mol reagents per mol TPA.
experiments.limitations: ["Unavoidable physical law: Enthalpy of amorphization and extrusion electrical work cannot be engineered away biologically.", "Oligomer precipitation (MHET solubility < 0.5 g/L at 25 \u00b0C) causes irreversible flux decay in ultrafiltration membranes.", "Enzymatic TPA ($1.55-$1.65/kg) requires a 50% green premium over chemical glycolysis ($1.05/kg) or fossil PTA ($1.15/kg)."]

experimental_results.raw_summary: Bi-PE achieved 52.4% on-target editing efficiency versus 28.1% for canonical PE3.
SpCas9 achieved 78.2% indel knockout at target site with 6.8% off-target indels.
0.13 mg/cm²/day mass loss at 30 °C; 60 mg film fully degraded after 6 weeks
~20% improvement in amorphous PET degradation rate over wild-type; active site cleft narrowed
90% depolymerization into terephthalic acid (TPA) and ethylene glycol (EG) within 9.3 hours at 3 mg enzyme / g PET loading
Complete depolymerization of untreated post-consumer amorphous containers in 24-48 hours at 50 °C; Tm increased by 8.2 °C
Reconciliation of commercial economics: Amorphization extruder energy accounts for 31% of total cost; NaOH/H2SO4 neutralization consumes 2.1 mol reagents per mol TPA.

claims.claim_statement: Bi-directional priming enhances prime editing efficiency by 1.8- to 2.5-fold over canonical PE3 across mammalian genomic loci.
claims.mechanistic_assertion: Simultaneous generation of homologous 3' flaps promotes flap annealing and mismatch repair.

claims.claim_statement: SpCas9 achieves high efficiency indel disruption exceeding 75% in transformed human cell lines.
claims.mechanistic_assertion: Double-strand break repair via error-prone NHEJ.

competitor_matches.strategic_takeaway: SpCas9 remains the standard for gene disruption and ex vivo knockout where high indel rates are acceptable. Prime Editing significantly expands therapeutic scope by enabling all 12 base conversions, insertions up to 100 bp, and deletions without double-strand breaks or donor DNA, but faces in vivo delivery bottlenecks due to protein size (>6 kb).

scientific_changes.title: Bi-Directional Priming (Bi-PE) Enhances Prime Editing Efficiency 2.5-fold
scientific_changes.previous_state: Canonical PE3 achieved 15% – 28% precise editing at difficult genomic targets with substantial byproduct indels.
scientific_changes.new_state: Bi-PE employs dual-opposing pegRNAs to achieve 45% – 60% editing efficiency with lower indel ratios.
scientific_changes.scientific_significance: Dual-flap homology prevents premature flap resection and stimulates preferential double-flap resolution.
scientific_changes.commercial_implication: Expands therapeutic viability to low-efficiency genomic loci previously considered untreatable by standard prime editors.
scientific_changes.diligence_questions: ["Does dual-pegRNA transfection increase off-target nicking rates at secondary homologous loci?", "What is the viral vector or LNP packaging efficiency when co-delivering two long pegRNAs?"]
